paper.title_en: Response to "Late Time Dynamical Dark Energy and the CMB-Distance Ladder Tension"
paper.abstract_en: We respond to the recent paper by Efstathiou (arXiv:2607.29562) who makes several statements that appear to be in conflict with our recent paper (Turner & Huterer, arXiv:2606.05358). We stand by our primary result that direct determinations of $H_0$ can be sensitive to the late-time expansion history. We also point out where there is significant agreement between his work and ours.
